title: Sion-Wolfe Game Has No Mixed Value
body_html:
Sion-Wolfe Game Has No Mixed Value

Let $S=T=[0,1]$ with the Borel sigma-algebra and define $$ f(s,t)= \begin{cases} -1, & s<t<s+1/2,\\ 0, & t=s\text{ or }t=s+1/2,\\ 1, & \text{otherwise}. \end{cases} $$ For the mixed extension over $\Delta(S)$ and $\Delta(T)$, MFoGT's exercise states that $$ \sup_{\sigma\in\Delta(S)}\inf_{t\in T} f(\sigma,t)=\frac13, $$ and asks to prove that the mixed game has no value.
